about.title: Personalized tour planning, with a human always in the loop.
about.copy: Voyara turns a destination, a budget, and a set of preferences into a bookable itinerary — then keeps that itinerary healthy as real life happens around it.

smartRecommendations.title: Smart recommendations, humans decide
smartRecommendations.body: Every automatically generated itinerary, disruption recovery, or budget change is a proposal. A human traveler, operator, or coordinator reviews and approves it before it takes effect.

builtForDisruptions.title: Built for real disruptions
builtForDisruptions.body: Flights get delayed and weather changes plans. Voyara traces the downstream impact of every disruption and ranks recovery options by cost, time, preference fit, and provider reliability.

oneWorkspace.title: One workspace per role
oneWorkspace.body: Travelers plan and live their trip, operators run the business behind it, vendors manage their own inventory, and coordinators see only the tours assigned to them.
